messages:
Aisha K.: Quick ask from the EU bank POC — Legal wants a concise artifact: a) definitive list of subprocessors we use for the hosted POC, b) a simple dataflow diagram showing where customer content, KV cache, and any logs live, and c) a statement on whether any customer data leaves the EU. They need this for vendor risk before kickoff, EOD Wed.

Samir P.: I can own the technical write-up + diagram. Two clarifying Qs: which model(s) are they calling (for mem/caching behavior) and are they planning to persist embeddings? That changes storage flow.

Aisha K.: They're testing with redwood/gpt-small for generation + embeddings for search. Embeddings retention is currently ON (they store for semantic search). They explicitly require KMS keys in the EU if anything is persisted.

Marta L.: For hosted POC note: inference and tokenization run in the selected region (eu-west-1). Default infra uses EU region for compute, but some ancillary services (metrics export, backup tooling) are routed to vendor-managed buckets unless we enable EU-only config. We have an EU-only POC bundle that disables cross-region telemetry and uses EU buckets. I'll pull the subprocessors list.

Samir P.: Short technical summary to include in the artifact (I'll expand into a diagram):
```
- Compute: inference nodes in eu-west-1 (no model weights or KV cache leave region).
- KV cache: ephemeral in-region (redis) for runtime only; TTL-based eviction.
- Persistent embeddings: optional; if enabled will be stored in customer-scoped S3 buckets in eu-west-1 (we can enforce EU-only).
- Logs: request/response logs are retained only when "retain_logs: true" — for POC we can set to false. Aggregated telemetry (metrics/traces) currently goes to hosted vendor monitoring — opt-in EU-only export available.
```

Samir P.: Also: if customer requires customer-managed KMS in EU we need Dedicated or Private with KMS integration. Hosted offers server-side keys managed in-region but not customer-managed keys.

Joyce (Legal): We need a single contract-friendly sentence for Risk: something like — "All customer content and derived artifacts (including embeddings) created during the POC will be processed and stored exclusively in EU regions (eu-west-1) and will not be transferred outside the EU, except to subprocessors that have documented safeguards and Standard Contractual Clauses in place." Can someone confirm accuracy and whether SC clauses are active for our current subprocessors?

Marta L.: Confirmed — our current subprocessors appendix for EU POCs includes: AWS (eu-west-1), RedisCloud (eu-west-1), Datadog (metrics — EU-only export enabled on request), Sentry (EU data residency enabled), and our backup vendor (object storage) — we can restrict backups to eu-west-1 for POCs. All of those have SCCs or equivalent in our DPA. I'll produce a short appendix file the lawyer can attach.

infra-bot: Confluence links (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/poc/eu-residency-bundle and https://confluence.redwood.ai/subprocessors/eu-poc-appendix (requestors: please check access).

Samir P.: Draft statement for Joyce to refine: "For the EU POC, inference, ephemeral caches, and (if enabled) persistent embeddings will be provisioned in eu-west-1. Telemetry and secondary exports are disabled by default for the POC; any telemetry exports can be configured to EU-only endpoints. Subprocessors engaged for the POC operate under contractual safeguards (DPA/SCCs) and are listed in the attached appendix."

Aisha K.: Perfect. Please attach the diagram + appendix when ready. I'll push to the customer's security contact and ask whether they require customer-managed KMS or if host-managed in-region keys are acceptable. If they insist on CMK in EU we'll flag that this would push them to Dedicated/Private path.

Marta L.: Will upload diagram + subprocessor appendix by EOD and add a small config snippet customers can copy to ensure EU-only exports.

Samir P.: Pasting quick config snippet (for docs):
```json
{
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "retain_logs": false,
  "embeddings": {
    "persist": true,
    "storage": "s3://redwood-eu-poc-bucket/",
    "kms_key_region": "eu-west-1"
  },
  "telemetry": {
    "metrics_export": "disabled",
    "traces_export": "eu-only"
  }
}
```

Aisha K.: Thanks everyone — I'll send the artifacts when they come in. If Legal needs any additional specific language I'll loop back here. :thumbsup:
